ASU medical school to serve the community ASU is creating a new kind of medical school that will focus on improving health outcomes for the community and serve as a hub for regional partnerships. Find out more Find my degree program I am a future The ASU difference: We are measured not by whom we exclude, but by whom we include and how they succeed Experience world-class academics Discovery and innovation that serves the public Serving all learners at every stage of life At Arizona State University, you'll join a community that will help you explore your interests and learn new skills. Through quality academics, enrichment opportunities and support from friends and faculty, you'll graduate prepared to accomplish your goals throughout your life. Find the experience that fits you. Stories of excellence Barrett, The Honors College Barrett students attend the best graduate schools, win international fellowships and accept positions with top companies. Barrett, The Honors College Deep sea research for better ocean health ASU students and scientists traveled below the ocean’s surface to study microbes living near deep-sea vents to better understand ocean health, climate change and how life survives in extreme environments. Deep sea research for better ocean health Turning Italy into a classroom ASU business students gained firsthand experience in global sports marketing at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan, turning the Games into a learning experience. Turning Italy into a classroom One university, many places New programs for all ages Ambition, curiosity, creativity and passion don't fit in any one box. No matter who you are or how you learn, ASU is ready to serve learners at every stage of life. ASU for You is the first step in a larger movement — a movement that's breaking down education barriers and building up high quality, affordable and accessible learning opportunities for everyone, from K-12 to midcareer to postretirement and every individual in between.
